nodes.What it is: A configuration is the set of numbers describing a robot pose, such as joint angles or vehicle position. Collision checking rejects configurations and connecting motions that intersect obstacles; a free endpoint alone is not enough.
nodes.Prerequisites: Coordinate frames; basic geometry. Arm-specific integration belongs to Manipulation: Collision-free arm motion generation.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Geometry, distance queries and conservative motion validation remain essential even when a neural network proposes the path. Collision discretization can miss thin obstacles. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: LaValle; Modern Robotics authors; TU Berlin IMRCLab; OMPL community
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: Dijkstra searches a graph for a cheapest route; A* uses a lower-bound distance estimate to focus that search. D* Lite reuses earlier search work when edge costs change, useful when a robot discovers a blocked passage.
nodes.Prerequisites: Graphs; priority queues; Configuration space & collision checking.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: A heuristic must satisfy the algorithm assumptions for optimality claims. A shortest route on a coarse grid is not necessarily a shortest executable robot trajectory. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: LaValle; Modern Robotics authors; TU Berlin IMRCLab; OMPL community
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: PRM builds a network of sampled safe states; RRT grows a tree toward random samples. RRT* improves solution quality with more samples, but finite computation does not promise the best path.
nodes.Prerequisites: Configuration space & collision checking; probability; graph search. Reuse Manipulation: Collision-free arm motion generation for arm execution, not a second arm pipeline.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: OMPL provides abstract state-space planners for vehicles, drones and manipulators, not a complete collision checker or visualizer. Benchmark multiple seeds and time budgets, including narrow passages. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: LaValle; Modern Robotics authors; TU Berlin IMRCLab; OMPL community
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: A path says where to go; a trajectory also says when. Time parameterization assigns speed along a path while respecting limits, while online trajectory generation can react to new target states.
nodes.Prerequisites: Paths; derivatives; velocity and acceleration limits; basic Control concepts.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Ruckig handles jerk-limited state-to-state trajectory generation; TOPPRA time-parameterizes given paths. Retiming or smoothing must be followed by constraint and collision checks; they are not interchangeable methods. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: LaValle; Modern Robotics authors; TU Berlin IMRCLab; OMPL community
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: Trajectory optimization adjusts a sequence of states or actions to reduce costs such as roughness, travel time and proximity to obstacles. CHOMP and TrajOpt are examples; an MPC-style planner repeats optimization after each new observation.
nodes.Prerequisites: Calculus; numerical optimization; trajectory constraints. Manipulation: Collision-free arm motion generation covers the arm-specific application.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Local optimizers can get stuck and penalty costs are not proof of safety. Compare initializations, feasible baselines and explicit constraint violations rather than attractive videos alone. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Requires extra mathematical/modeling work and careful evaluation; GPU access may be needed for published models.

nodes.What it is: A navigation stack joins map handling, route planning, path following and recovery behaviors. A costmap turns sensor and map information into traversal costs, including the space a robot body needs around obstacles.
nodes.Prerequisites: Graph search & incremental replanning; ROS 2; supplied localization and transforms (SLAM itself is outside this branch).
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Nav2 separates planners, controllers and behaviors into servers and plugins. Treat unknown space, stale observations and footprint inflation explicitly; navigation software is not a certified safety system. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: Local planners choose the next short motion using nearby obstacles and a longer route. DWA samples admissible velocities, MPPI samples action rollouts, and TEB optimizes a timed band; these are different tradeoffs, not universal replacements.
nodes.Prerequisites: Navigation stacks & costmaps; vehicle motion models; basic feedback control.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: MPPI parallel rollout optimization is well established; controller tuning still depends on dynamics, horizon and sensor delay. A short horizon can prefer a dead end, and moving people require conservative testing. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Requires extra mathematical/modeling work and careful evaluation; GPU access may be needed for published models.

nodes.What it is: A behavior tree connects small actions and conditions into a reactive program. Unlike a planner that invents a sequence, an executive runs and interrupts actions, checks results and chooses recovery branches.
nodes.Prerequisites: Async programming; finite-state machines; ROS actions for integration. For manipulation task-and-motion coupling, see Long-horizon / task-and-motion planning.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: BehaviorTree.CPP provides asynchronous actions, XML trees and logging; Nav2 uses trees to orchestrate servers. Correct cancellation, timeout and failure propagation matter more than tree size. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: PDDL describes actions using conditions that must hold and effects that change the world. A symbolic planner finds an action sequence, but it cannot guarantee geometric feasibility unless another component checks it.
nodes.Prerequisites: Logic; search; Behavior trees & task executives. Cross-reference Manipulation: Long-horizon / task-and-motion planning for joint symbolic/geometric manipulation.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: PlanSys2 provides a ROS 2 PDDL planning framework. Model missing facts and failed effects explicitly; do not mistake a valid symbolic plan for successful physical execution. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: A car cannot slide sideways, and a flying robot cannot change velocity instantly. Kinodynamic planning searches motions that obey dynamics; lattices and Hybrid A* account for heading and permitted motion primitives for vehicles.
nodes.Prerequisites: Sampling-based motion planning; differential equations; vehicle models; trajectory limits.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Choose a model and steering or propagation method that matches the platform. Car-like search and drone dynamics are not interchangeable; a collision-free geometric curve may still be impossible to fly or drive. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors

nodes.What it is: Multi-agent path finding assigns time-aware routes so robots do not collide or swap through each other. Conflict-based search resolves conflicts between individual routes; task allocation and physical tracking are separate problems.
nodes.Prerequisites: Graph search & incremental replanning; discrete time; collision definitions.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Grid MAPF makes strong assumptions about timing and robot size. Delays and continuous footprints need additional checking, so an optimal discrete schedule is not proof of safe fleet execution. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
nodes.Key players: Nav2 / Open Navigation; PlanSys2; BehaviorTree.CPP; cited method authors
nodes._accessibility_reason: Small, visible software-only experiments fit existing coding skills.

nodes.What it is: Coverage plans visit an entire region rather than just reaching one goal. Sweep patterns and cell decomposition help inspection, cleaning and agriculture account for tool width, overlaps and obstacles.
nodes.Prerequisites: Geometry; graph search; robot turning constraints.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Fields2Cover implements agricultural coverage building blocks. Coverage percentage must include inaccessible areas and turning feasibility; a pretty sweep plot alone does not prove all reachable space was serviced. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.

nodes.What it is: An MDP chooses actions with uncertain outcomes; a POMDP also handles uncertainty about the current state. A belief is a distribution over possible states, allowing actions that gather information before committing to a route.
nodes.Prerequisites: Probability; Bayes rule; value iteration; graph search. State estimation is a prerequisite, not remapped here.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: POMDPs.jl separates models and solvers. A 2026 semantic-uncertainty planning preprint connects task specifications and kinodynamic search; guarantees depend on its stated model assumptions and do not cover arbitrary perception errors. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.

nodes.What it is: Many candidate motions can be checked or optimized simultaneously on a GPU. This accelerates planning components rather than removing geometry, dynamics or safety constraints.
nodes.Prerequisites: Sampling-based motion planning; Optimization-based trajectory planning; CUDA-capable computing. Arm applications stay in Manipulation: Collision-free arm motion generation.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: The cuRobo site reports 2026 whole-body and GPU planning updates, beyond its original arm-focused release. Treat vendor timing claims as setup-specific and measure synchronization, memory and collision fidelity on available hardware. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.

nodes.What it is: A learned planner predicts useful paths, samples or costs from training examples. Diffusion planners generate several possible trajectories by iterative denoising, but predictions still need validity checks and fallback planning.
nodes.Prerequisites: Sampling-based motion planning; neural networks; train/test splits; collision validation.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: Cascaded Diffusion Models for Neural Motion Planning (2025) combines coarse and fine prediction with online repair across navigation and manipulation domains. This is a bounded paper result, not a general safety guarantee or proof of unseen-environment reliability. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.

nodes.What it is: A language model can propose skills or translate instructions into a formal planning problem. Grounding checks whether the robot actually has the skills and whether preconditions and observed results match the plan.
nodes.Prerequisites: Symbolic task planning with PDDL; Behavior trees & task executives. Manipulation-specific integration remains in Long-horizon / task-and-motion planning, not duplicated here.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: SayCan grounds skill selection in affordance scores; Code as Policies generates programs; LLM+P delegates formal search to a planner. EmboTeam (2026 preprint) adds monitored multi-robot grounding; none licenses unguarded model-generated robot commands. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.

nodes.What it is: A world model predicts the result of candidate actions, letting a planner imagine alternatives before executing a short prefix. This differs from simply replaying a learned policy: the planner evaluates predicted futures at decision time.
nodes.Prerequisites: Planning under uncertainty & belief space; neural networks; MPC; dataset coverage.
nodes.Frontier state 2026: DINO-WM (2024) plans over pretrained visual features; LaDi-WM (CoRL 2025) couples predicted latent states to policies. A 2026 preprint explores RRT/KPIECE with world-model propagation; model errors can be exploited by search, so validate closed-loop outcomes. Snapshot of opened sources, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking.
